data.text:
No thermal hazard forecast at this time — sensor coverage issue remains.

- S1 Rack-A temp still stuck at 26.77C, std 0 / flat_suspect true. That is lost coverage of Rack A, not evidence Rack A is safe.
- S2, S3, M1, M2 fresh and normal with no trend: Desk1 ~26.5C, Return ~22.8C, UPS ~4.59kW stable, Rack-B drop noisy ~83mV with no sustained rise.
- Cross-check hidden-zone regression: rackB 28.3C margin -6.7C, desk2 26.3C margin -5.7C, connector 29.8C margin -40.2C — all within simulated limits, but flagged unreliable because S1 is flat.
- Physics twin: load_rackB ~1.23x posterior 1.0, p_breach 0, peak margin -5.6C over 90min. No breach plausible, so no warn/critical.
- Tested dispatch_human_check and shed_noncritical_load for 60min: both do-nothing vs with-action -5.6C, p_breach 0. Dispatch is inspection/repair in the simulation, not proven thermal prevention.

A human check/inspection for S1 / Rack-A was already approved and pending — do-nothing now means no additional action until it takes effect. No new action requested. Info-level sensor fault only.
